Seismic Minimum Reading

A seismic sensor array has N sensors arranged in a line. You are given an initial array of readings. A monitoring system processes two types of operations in real time:

Type 1: 1 i x — Update the reading of sensor i (0-indexed) to value x.

Type 2: 2 l r — Query the minimum sensor reading in the range [l, r] (0-indexed, inclusive).

Handle all operations efficiently and output results of all type 2 queries on separate lines.
explanation: Use a Segment Tree for Range Minimum Query with Point Updates. Build the tree bottom-up over the array. Point updates propagate upward from leaf to root in O(log N). Range minimum queries use the standard recursive approach or iterative bottom-up approach in O(log N). Both operations total O((N + Q) log N).
